ja:en:000000179.usage_en: Use for a physical place in context; also has other nominal and grammatical senses which are separate.
ja:en:000000179.context_en: Choosing a quiet physical place to read.

examples.text: 静かなところで本を読みます。

translations.pt-BR: Vou ler um livro em um lugar tranquilo.
translations.en-US: I will read a book in a quiet place.

representations.usage_en: Kanji spelling for the physical-place sense; shares the same form identity.
